scope: Focused review of 17 changed runtime TS/TSX/CSS modules, their diffs and relevant persistence/reference context. Not a penetration test, exhaustive dependency audit or full upstream compatibility certification.
notes: A reserved source view-ID validation bug was reproduced before fixing the validation dictionary to use a null prototype. Regression tests now require retained messages and blocked Save for __proto__, constructor and toString IDs.
No remaining confirmed security findings were identified in the reviewed runtime changes. No secret-pattern matches were found in the 17 changed runtime modules.

GitHub discovery constructs public API/Raw URLs, validates commit/tree metadata and encoded paths, excludes symlinks/submodules, rejects partial trees, and applies byte/node/depth/count/time bounds. Requests omit credentials/referrers and send no local character, photo or backup records.
Source-form commands validate base fields and exact resource pins in transactions. New views use React text and whitelisted colors; imported events and rendering-time rolls remain unsupported.
Runtime dependency audit found zero known vulnerabilities. Existing build-tool advisories, local-storage risks, manual fallback conflicts and partial source semantics remain documented separately.

previous_scan.scope: Source review of 27 security-relevant modules/configurations covering import, evaluation, persistence, rendering, local fixture scripts and CI. Not a penetration test or exhaustive dependency audit.
notes: Unsupported initializer options, dynamic destinations, implicit/concurrent sequences and calculated aggregation now fail atomically; regression tests pass.
Secret-pattern search matched only an intentional invalid-URL test credential, not a configured secret.
No imported HTML/script execution sink or remote image fetch was found; HTTPS downloads are explicit and omit credentials/referrers.
Existing build-chain dependency advisories and accepted local-storage/host risks remain documented separately.
